question: Which two countries will co-host the 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belgium and Netherlands.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The 2026 FIH Hockey World Cup will be co-hosted by Belgium and the Netherlands in a historic dual-host format.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Belgium (Wavre) and Netherlands (Amsterdam) will jointly host both men’s and women’s tournaments.
 
• The event runs from 15 to 30 August 2026 with 16 teams per gender.
 
• Men’s final will be held in Wavre, while the women’s final will be in Amsterdam.
 
• This edition includes the first-ever ParaHockey World Cup to promote inclusivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Wavre – Belfius Hockey Arena**__

 __
 
• Main venue in Belgium.
 
• Hosts the men’s final.
 
• Modern international-standard facility.
 
 
 
• **Amsterdam – Wagener Stadium**__
 __
 
• Main Dutch venue.
 
• Hosts the women’s final.
 
• One of the world’s most iconic hockey stadiums.
 
 
 
• **New Tournament Format**__
 __
 
• 16 teams divided into 4 groups per gender.
 
• Top two teams enter second-round group phase carrying forward results.
 
• Ensures fairer progression and sustained competition intensity.
 
 
 
• **ParaHockey World Cup**__
 
 
• First time included in the FIH World Cup lineup.
 
• Features athletes with intellectual disabilities.
 
• Held at the same venues as the main event.
